settings.title: The Long
settings.summary: Austin roses and flocked ranunculus, kept low so you can talk across the table.
settings.ingredients:
1 | Austin Roses | Baby Pink | 6 stems | B0DTFNXBHF | #e6b7b5 | /?view=sskoi-austin#color=Baby+Pink
1 | Flocked Ranunculus | Light Peach | 4 stems | B0DTYG3SY1 | #eac3a9 | /?view=sskoi-peony#color=Light+Peach
settings.vessel_name: Low footed stoneware bowl with a flower frog
settings.method:
Set the six roses first, low and turned outward, so the heads rest just above the rim.
Tuck the ranunculus between the roses and let the buds rise a little higher.
Walk around the table and turn the bowl until it looks full from every chair.
settings.alt: Austin roses and flocked ranunculus, kept low so you can talk across the table.

settings.title: Morning
settings.summary: White tulips with white ranunculus in clear glass, for a counter by the window.
settings.ingredients:
1 | Real-Touch Tulips | White | 12 stems | B0DQDXM72R | #f4eee2 | /?view=sskoi-tulip#color=White
1 | Flocked Ranunculus | White | 4 stems | B0DTYJ5V1W | #f4eee2 | /?view=sskoi-peony#color=White
settings.method:
Stand the twelve tulips upright and let them fall open toward the rim.
Add the ranunculus at the front, a little lower than the tulips.
Keep the stems visible through the glass; they are part of the look.
settings.alt: White tulips with white ranunculus in clear glass, for a counter by the window.

settings.title: Coral
settings.summary: Coral roses and orange ranunculus in a stone jug beside a reading chair.
settings.ingredients:
1 | Classic Roses | Coral | 6 stems | B0DSWT9NMF | #d98268 | /?view=sskoi-classic#color=Coral
1 | Flocked Ranunculus | Orange | 4 stems | B0DTYBG3DP | #dc884d | /?view=sskoi-peony#color=Orange
settings.method:
Place the roses first and let a few buds lean out toward the chair.
Add the ranunculus lower, near the lip of the jug.
Leave one side lighter than the other so the arrangement looks gathered, not packed.
settings.alt: Coral roses and orange ranunculus in a stone jug beside a reading chair.

settings.title: Mantel in
settings.summary: Baby pink and white Austin roses with eucalyptus trailing over the edge of the mantel.
settings.ingredients:
1 | Austin Roses with Eucalyptus | Baby Pink | 6 roses and 6 eucalyptus stems | B0FLLPR1W9 | #e6b7b5 | https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FLLPR1W9?th=1
1 | Austin Roses | White | 6 stems | B0DTFNZQRG | #f4eee2 | /?view=sskoi-austin#color=White
settings.method:
Set the eucalyptus first, letting two stems trail down one side.
Add the white roses at the center, then the pink roses around them.
Step back to the far side of the room and correct the outline from there.
settings.alt: Baby pink and white Austin roses with eucalyptus trailing over the edge of the mantel.

settings.title: By the
settings.summary: One set of baby pink ranunculus, split between two bud vases.
settings.ingredients: 1 | Flocked Ranunculus | Baby Pink | 4 stems | B0DTYL1GYT | #e6b7b5 | /?view=sskoi-peony#color=Baby+Pink
settings.method:
Put two stems in each vase.
Set one vase a little forward of the other.
Keep the flowers below the lampshade so the light falls on them.
settings.alt: One set of baby pink ranunculus, split between two bud vases.

settings.title: The
settings.summary: The burgundy gift set in its own paper vase, paired with dark purple tulips in glass.
settings.ingredients:
1 | Classic Rose Gift Set | Burgundy | 8 stems and paper vase | B0FKJ6Y2FQ | #6d283f | /?view=sskoi-rose-gift#color=Burgundy
1 | Real-Touch Tulips | Dark Purple | 12 stems | B0DQDVL846 | #654181 | /?view=sskoi-tulip#color=Dark+Purple
settings.vessel_name: Paper vase from the gift set, and a tall glass vase
settings.method:
Open the gift box into its standing vase and arrange the eight roses.
Stand the tulips upright in the glass vase.
Place the two vases a hand’s width apart, the taller one at the back.
settings.alt: The burgundy gift set in its own paper vase, paired with dark purple tulips in glass.

settings.title: Garden
settings.summary: Tulips, Austin roses and ranunculus in pinks and green, loose like a cut-garden bunch.
settings.ingredients:
1 | Real-Touch Tulips | Green With Pink Tip | 12 stems | B0DQF16XSS | #c5c6a3 | /?view=sskoi-tulip#color=Green+With+Pink+Tip
1 | Austin Roses | Pink | 6 stems | B0DTFPD9F9 | #d982a6 | /?view=sskoi-austin#color=Pink
1 | Flocked Ranunculus | Pink | 4 stems | B0DTYBPB9F | #d982a6 | /?view=sskoi-peony#color=Pink
settings.method:
Start with the tulips around the rim, leaning out.
Place the roses in the middle at different heights.
Fill the gaps with the ranunculus and let the buds stand above the roses.
settings.alt: Tulips, Austin roses and ranunculus in pinks and green, loose like a cut-garden bunch.

settings.title: Late
settings.summary: Burgundy classic roses and purple Austin roses for an evening table.
settings.ingredients:
1 | Classic Roses | Burgundy | 6 stems | B0DSXY4KDH | #6d283f | /?view=sskoi-classic#color=Burgundy
1 | Austin Roses | Purple | 6 stems | B0DTFNB9BG | #9473b3 | /?view=sskoi-austin#color=Purple
settings.method:
Set the Austin roses low around the rim.
Raise the classic roses above them, with the buds at the top.
Light the table from the side; the dark petals need it.
settings.alt: Burgundy classic roses and purple Austin roses for an evening table.
